summary_paraphrase: A king who dozes all day and lies awake all night collects sleep remedies from his court (a rich dinner, music, a walk, a story) and tries them all in one night, each failing comically; his queen settles him with milk and a massage, a nightly routine slowly works, but his late nights have kept the whole city awake, so the people gather and a spreading wave of yawns brings sleep to everyone.

beats.function: the king's day-sleepiness, named with a joke
each remedy fails comically in one night
the queen settles him; a routine slowly works
his nights kept the whole city awake

characters.name: Kottavi Raja (Raja Nalan)
characters.change: from impatient and sleepless to rested, then worried for his people

repetition.description: each courtier offers a remedy, then each remedy is tried and fails
repetition.why: a set-up list paid off by a failure list

repetition.description: chains of people (the sleepless city; the spreading yawn)
repetition.why: the yawn chain enacts the ending's contagion

repetition.description: the remedies return as a routine that shortens week by week

notes: Level 3 reader layout: long text pages, several without pictures.
The musicians asleep while the king is awake is the clearest picture joke.

strengths: a comic failure sequence before the solution
the ending widens from one sleeper to a whole city
calm moonlit last page after a funny peak
weaknesses: the king's own fix comes from the queen; a second resolution is needed for the city
a 7-8 book with an adult protagonist

anti_patterns.note: the queen's milk-and-massage fixes in one line what four remedies could not

child_appeal_heuristic.rationale: Scores are the analyst's reading of the pages, not observations of children.
child_appeal_heuristic.label: Research heuristic — not validated

age_suitability.notes: No peril. Peak research intensity 3/5 (about 2 on the engine's 0-3 scale) is comic frustration; it sits late (pages 14-16 of 17) because the book adds a second, city-wide problem before winding down to a calm last page.

metrics.lexicon_note: direct_address and sound_words are lexicon counts: a floor, not a measure. direct_address counts second-person words anywhere, dialogue included — it is not narrator-to-reader address

repetition.end_rhyme_note: heuristic: consecutive lines sharing a final two letters
